mapper.select: WITH ThemeUsage AS ( SELECT theme, SUM(value) AS total_usage FROM ( SELECT p.pf_rest, p.pf_sport, p.pf_walk, p.pf_cafe, p.pf_spot FROM OrderTour ot JOIN Tour t ON ot.t_no = t.t_no JOIN Preference p ON t.pf_no = p.pf_no ) UNPIVOT ( value FOR theme IN (pf_rest AS '힐링', pf_sport AS '스포츠', pf_walk AS '산책', pf_cafe AS '카페', pf_spot AS '장소') ) GROUP BY theme ) SELECT theme, total_usage, ROUND((total_usage / SUM(total_usage) OVER ()) * 100, 2) AS usage_percentage FROM ThemeUsage ORDER BY usage_percentage DESC
select o.pd_no as pd_no, p.pd_name as pd_name, sum(o.oi_price) as sum from orderitem o inner join product p on o.pd_no = p.pd_no group by o.pd_no, p.pd_name order by o.pd_no
SELECT TO_CHAR(PAYT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS PAYT_DATE , NVL(SUM(PAYT_TOTAL), 0) AS TOTAL_SALES FROM PAYMENTTOUR GROUP BY TO_CHAR(PAYT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY PAYT_DATE
